sources: Search snippets 2026-11-05: Nebraska WMA rule 'camping is allowed on Nebraska WMAs for up to 14 nights unless otherwise posted' (directory restating NGPC); https://www.campendium.com/hull-lake-state-wildlife-area ('Hull Lake SWA Dispersed Camping', grass pads, 14-day max); https://www.howsyourriver.com/access_sites/hull-lake-wildlife-management-area (no fees or reservations)
Esri World Imagery at the pin (1.8 px/m)
note: Small NGPC wildlife management area (36 acres) with a 3-acre lake, ~3 mi S and 1 mi W of Butte. Undesignated primitive camping, as on other Nebraska WMAs (14 nights unless posted): an open grassy area at the entrance above the lake and a small turnaround by the dam. No services; free. Both spots can be hard to level. --Claude
summary: Dispersed WMA camping, no designated sites: ownership wma is right under the wildlife-agency rule. The lake is ~3 acres (imagery ~4-5 acres at most), under the pond line -> lakeview must become not waterfront. Inclusion as a wma entry rests on the general NGPC WMA camping allowance; flag only.
flags: WATERFRONT lakeview -> not waterfront: the stored note's '3-acre lake' and imagery (~120 x 200 m irregular, ~4-5 acres at most) put it under the ~5-acre pond line, so no lake value. (The entrance clearing is ~100 m above the north end; the turnaround by the dam ~20 m from the water.)

INCLUSION (wildlife-agency rule): no designated sites - Campendium calls it 'Hull Lake SWA Dispersed Camping' on grass pads, and the only rule found is the general NGPC WMA allowance (14 nights unless posted). That is an allowance, so ownership stays wma (already stored). NGPC's location page is blocked, so I could not quote its current wording.

FIT: a gravel lane runs from the county road to the entrance clearing (~40 x 40 m, 42.8681,-98.8806) and on to a loop turnaround at the dam (~42.8662,-98.8813); both take a 23-ft rig, though uneven. SAND: not applicable (grass/gravel).
PIN 42.86721,-98.88092 is on the lane between the two spots (~90 m from each); fine.
PHONE: none stored; directories give (402) 296-0041 (NGPC district office per listings, unconfirmed). Website is the right NGPC page (blocked).
